name: Arata Oratorio

source:
Character Design - Akisoba (秋蕎麦)

A Sage with much knowledge and experience. She is very open towards the opposite sex and tends to tease [url=/c16748]Leo[/url]. A bespectacled beauty who loves alcohol.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valkyrie_Complex]Wikipedia[/url].]
